## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

**1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?**
RISK-OFF. Breadth: 5/11 sectors positive. Confirmations: defensives leading (JNJ (1W: +4.81% | 1M: +9.10%) ABOVE TREND, EL (1W: +11.78% | 1M: +18.99%) ABOVE TREND, PFE (1W: +7.34% | 1M: +15.21%) ABOVE TREND) and Financials + Industrials both negative (Financials 1W: -0.83%, Industrials 1W: -2.16%); Leadership: Broad (4 sectors in Top 5).

**2. Which sectors are leading?**
Healthcare leads: MRK (1W: +14.50% | 1M: +20.54%) ABOVE TREND, GILD (1W: +8.63% | 1M: +13.29%) ABOVE TREND, ABBV (1W: +6.92% | 1M: +4.97%) ABOVE TREND. Energy strong: PSX (1W: +7.98% | 1M: +16.66%) ABOVE TREND, XOM (1W: +3.81% | 1M: +9.31%) ABOVE TREND.

**3. Which sectors are lagging?**
Technology lagging: AVGO (1W: -12.88% | 1M: -6.21%) BELOW TREND, AMAT (1W: -9.48% | 1M: -12.11%) BELOW TREND, LRCX (1W: -5.81% | 1M: -4.61%) BELOW TREND. Industrials weak: DE (1W: -6.32% | 1M: -1.06%) BELOW TREND, CAT (1W: -4.61% | 1M: -8.29%) BELOW TREND.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

**4. Top Performing Stocks?**
Top 5: MRK (1W: +14.50% | 1M: +20.54%) ABOVE TREND, EL (1W: +11.78% | 1M: +18.99%) ABOVE TREND, GILD (1W: +8.63% | 1M: +13.29%) ABOVE TREND, INTU (1W: +8.29% | 1M: +25.02%) ABOVE TREND, NFLX (1W: +8.10% | 1M: +16.82%) ABOVE TREND. Leadership: Broad (4 sectors in Top 5) — defensive/health and select tech/comms participation.

**5. Worst Performing Stocks?**
Bottom 5: AVGO (1W: -12.88% | 1M: -6.21%) BELOW TREND, CSCO (1W: -10.76% | 1M: -1.45%) BELOW TREND, AMAT (1W: -9.48% | 1M: -12.11%) BELOW TREND, INTC (1W: -8.07% | 1M: -12.00%) BELOW TREND, NUE (1W: -8.49% | 1M: +6.66%) CORRECTION. Weakness concentrated in large-cap Technology and select Materials.

**6. Momentum Stocks?**
Strongest 1W movers: MRK (1W: +14.50% | 1M: +20.54%) ABOVE TREND, EL (1W: +11.78% | 1M: +18.99%) ABOVE TREND, GILD (1W: +8.63% | 1M: +13.29%) ABOVE TREND; watch TSLA (1W: +7.21% | 1M: -7.34%) RECOVERY — a tactical rebound, not yet monthly confirmation.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

**7. Technology Outlook?**
Technology is under pressure and showing CORRECTION/BELOW TREND patterns: NVDA (1W: -2.91% | 1M: +4.95%) CORRECTION, MSFT (1W: -1.65% | 1M: +21.76%) CORRECTION, INTU (1W: +8.29% | 1M: +25.02%) ABOVE TREND, AMAT (1W: -9.48% | 1M: -12.11%) BELOW TREND; sector 1W performance negative and leadership is mixed.

**8. Financials Outlook?**
Financials are mixed to weak 1W: V (1W: +1.70% | 1M: +2.92%) ABOVE TREND, MA (1W: +2.50% | 1M: +6.58%) ABOVE TREND, but large banks like JPM (1W: -2.17% | 1M: +3.48%) CORRECTION and sector 1W -0.83% indicates caution and incision of risk-off flows.

**9. Healthcare Outlook?**
Healthcare is a clear relative strength pocket: MRK (1W: +14.50% | 1M: +20.54%) ABOVE TREND, PFE (1W: +7.34% | 1M: +15.21%) ABOVE TREND, JNJ (1W: +4.81% | 1M: +9.10%) ABOVE TREND — broad accumulation with positive 1W and 1M confirmation.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

**10. Portfolio Recommendation?**
Favor defensives and quality cyclicals: increase exposure to Healthcare (MRK, PFE, JNJ) and selective Energy (PSX, XOM) while reducing exposure to high-beta Technology and Industrials showing 1W weakness (AVGO, AMAT, DE). Style: mixed / no clear leadership, but defensive bias warranted in this RISK-OFF backdrop.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?**
BULLISH: MRK (1W: +14.50% | 1M: +20.54%) ABOVE TREND — trial success momentum; EL (1W: +11.78% | 1M: +18.99%) ABOVE TREND — earnings follow-through; PSX (1W: +7.98% | 1M: +16.66%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: META (1W: -5.67% | 1M: -15.19%) BELOW TREND — legal/sentiment risk, AVGO (1W: -12.88% | 1M: -6.21%) BELOW TREND — headline pressure, AMAT (1W: -9.48% | 1M: -12.11%) BELOW TREND.

**12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?**
BULLISH: Healthcare (1W: +4.00%) — momentum and positive news flow; Energy (1W: +3.76%) — macro/cash flow narrative. BEARISH: Technology (1W: -2.16%) and Industrials (1W: -2.16%) — watch for continuing outflows.

**13. Key Levels & Triggers?**
NVDA (1W: -2.91% | 1M: +4.95%) CORRECTION — watch for re-test of multi-week support for conviction. AAPL (1W: +4.82% | 1M: -3.25%) RECOVERY — monitor follow-through above recent swing high. JPM (1W: -2.17% | 1M: +3.48%) CORRECTION — a break lower would signal deeper financial-sector weakness.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

**14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?**
MRK (+80): cancer vaccine trial success; price confirming as MRK (1W: +14.50% | 1M: +20.54%) ABOVE TREND — sentiment confirmed. GM (+80): guidance lift; GM (not in SP100 top list but sentiment strong) — watch for industrial spillover. NVDA (+50): bullish price target headlines; NVDA (1W: -2.91% | 1M: +4.95%) CORRECTION — news positive but price showing short-term distribution, monitor.

**15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?**
META (-50): legal/social trials; META (1W: -5.67% | 1M: -15.19%) BELOW TREND — sentiment and price aligned. AVGO (-50): vendor/partner warning; AVGO (1W: -12.88% | 1M: -6.21%) BELOW TREND — headline confirmed by sharp price weakness. NUE (-50): large insider/portfolio sales headline; NUE (1W: -8.49% | 1M: +6.66%) CORRECTION — sentiment negative while monthly still positive, watch for follow-through.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

RISK-OFF, style mixed / no clear leadership. MRK (1W: +14.50% | 1M: +20.54%) ABOVE TREND, PFE (1W: +7.34% | 1M: +15.21%) ABOVE TREND and EL (1W: +11.78% | 1M: +18.99%) ABOVE TREND are showing relative strength. Key risk: defensive concentration while Tech and Industrials weaken — monitor sentiment divergences on META (-50) and NVDA (+50) for confirmation.
